gloss.sigma_predication: scope of predication: bounded event -> individual-level property of the self
gloss.tau_temporal: temporal quantification: one past act -> universal over the lifetime
gloss.epsilon_commitment: speaker's epistemic commitment to the self-ascription
gloss.delta_domain: width of the domain of other people quantified over
gloss.alpha_agency: loss of agency: agent of an act -> patient of a property
gloss.kappa_free: anaphoric freedom: bound to the birthday event vs free-standing claim about the person

sigma_predication.why: complement is an event ('send her the invitation'); nothing is predicated of the self

tau_temporal.why: 'keep' iterates the wishing, but its content is one bounded past act

epsilon_commitment.why: 'wish' + past perfect = counterfactual desire; asserts nothing about the self

alpha_agency.why: 'I ... remembered', 'I ... send': the self is agent throughout

kappa_free.why: lexically bound to the cause: 'invitation', 'remembered to send'

sigma_predication.why: 'stupid' is a property word but sits under 'feel' and is tied to the episode

tau_temporal.why: present-tense feeling about a bounded past act

epsilon_commitment.why: 'feel X that P': P is presupposed (factive), but 'feel' not 'am' hedges the property

delta_domain.why: 'one of my closest friends': still one referent, but a partitive evokes the set

alpha_agency.why: matrix subject is an experiencer; the self is still agent of the omission

kappa_free.why: still bound to the cause: 'forgot to include'

sigma_predication.why: predicate is an ability ('be able to connect'): a disposition, not an event

tau_temporal.why: 'will ever': NPI under a question-embedding verb, unbounded future

epsilon_commitment.why: 'wonder if' embeds an INTERROGATIVE - nothing is asserted; 'have started to' hedges again

delta_domain.why: 'good people': bare plural, kind-level. Domain jumps from a person to a kind

alpha_agency.why: 'connect with' is agentive but embedded under 'be able to': capacity, not act

kappa_free.why: the event is gone: no Anna, no birthday, no invitation

sigma_predication.why: copular 'I am just not interesting enough': individual-level property of the self

tau_temporal.why: individual-level predicates are temporally unbounded by default

epsilon_commitment.why: 'believe' is doxastic and commits; hedged only by 'am starting to' and 'just'

delta_domain.why: 'to hold on to' has an arbitrary implicit subject: anyone at all

alpha_agency.why: the self is the OBJECT of 'hold on to' and subject of a copula

sigma_predication.why: 'lovable': -able marks inherent potential - individual-level and modal

tau_temporal.why: 'my whole life': explicit universal quantification over the lifespan

epsilon_commitment.why: 'certain that': full commitment, no hedge anywhere in the clause

delta_domain.why: 'lovable' = by anyone; 'alone' = universal negation of all company

alpha_agency.why: -able is passive-potential: the self is patient of an unrealised loving; 'deserve' delivers a verdict on the self
